The bottom-left panel of the reference shows an identical presentation: a dead, rotted stem/root system with the characteristic **blue fungal growth** (Fusarium virguliforme sporulation) visible on the surface — exactly matching the test image.

Key evidence:
- **Blue/teal fungal growth** on the stem/root surface — the hallmark of SDS in moist conditions
- Brown to gray dead stem tissue at the base
- Completely dead, rotted root system with the plant collapsed
